 Fresh & Ready Foods LLC is recalling 2,414 of Fresh To You Sausage, Egg & Cheese Biscuit Sandwiches (4.6 oz) because it has the potential to be contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes. The recalled Fresh To You Sausage, Egg & Cheese Biscuit Sandwiches were produced at a Fresh & Ready facility in Renton, Washington and were distributed in Oregon and Washington to employee break rooms, refrigerated vending, and cafeterias between October 25 and November 4, 2026. Business Wire Sun, November 8, 2026 at 6:03 AM PST 2 min read Fresh & Ready Foods LLC is recalling 2,414 of Fresh To You Sausage, Egg & Cheese Biscuit Sandwiches (4.6 oz) because it has the potential to be contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes. The recalled Fresh To You Sausage, Egg & Cheese Biscuit Sandwiches were produced at a Fresh & Ready facility in Renton, Washington and were distributed in Oregon and Washington to employee break rooms, refrigerated vending, and cafeterias between October 25 and November 4, 2026. RENTON, Wash., November 08, 2026 --( BUSINESS WIRE )-- Fresh & Ready Foods LLC of Renton, WA is recalling 2,414 of Fresh To You Sausage, Egg & Cheese Biscuit Sandwiches (4.6 oz) because it has the potential to be contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes , an organism which can cause serious and sometimes fatal infections in young children, frail or elderly people, and others with weakened immune systems. Although healthy individuals may suffer only short-term symptoms such as high fever, severe headache, stiffness, nausea, abdominal pain and diarrhea. Listeria monocytogenes infection can cause miscarriages and stillbirths among pregnant women. 
 The recalled Fresh To You Sausage, Egg & Cheese Biscuit Sandwiches were produced at a Fresh & Ready facility in Renton, Washington and were distributed in Oregon and Washington to employee break rooms, refrigerated vending, and cafeterias between October 25 and November 4, 2026. 
 This recall is in connection with a recall initiated by CH Guenther & Son for certain biscuit products that may be contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes. Fresh & Ready Foods used the affected biscuit as an ingredient only in the specific product listed below. 
 PRODUCT 
 SKU & UPC 
 USE BY / GOOD THRU DATES 
 WHERE DATE CAN BE FOUND 
 Fresh to You Sausage, Egg & Cheese Biscuit Sandwich.
4.6 oz packaged in clear plastic film 
 SKU 3100048
UPC 8 405493 0168 4 
 Fresh Thru: 11/07-11/19 
 Front label 
 No other Fresh To You or Fresh & Ready Foods products, production dates, or products manufactured at other Fresh & Ready facilities are impacted. 
 No illnesses have been reported to date. 
 Consumers who have purchased the affected product are urged not to consume the product and discard any remaining product immediately. 
 Consumers with questions or who would like to request a full refund may contact Fresh & Ready Foods by email at RecallConcern@HotLineGlobal.com or by calling 1-855-424-8390, Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. ET.
